deep_dive.title: Compressing Onboard Language Models for Space Robots under a Behavioral-Fidelity Requirement
deep_dive.abstract: Language models are being explored as the interface through which space robots interpret operator commands and select among verified skills. Running them onboard calls for low-bit compression, and flight use adds requirements that generic post-training quantization leaves implicit: a fixed memory budget and storage format, a static artifact under configuration control, and behavior close to the full-precision model validated on the ground. We treat compression as a ground-segment step and study QSelect, which composes one static low-bit model from compatible AWQ, GPTQ, and AutoRound checkpoints by assigning each linear module to one quantizer family and scoring every substitution at the final next-token distribution. The default fidelity mode needs no labels or tuned thresholds and accepts a substitution only when the forward KL divergence from the BF16 reference decreases; an optional target-adapted mode adds answer likelihood on a small labeled set. On DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B, Llama-3.1-8B, and Llama-3.2-3B at 3 and 4 bits, composed models reach lower mean held-out perplexity than every single-family model in all six settings, and the fidelity mode lowers perplexity and KL further. In a matched scaffold, final-output scoring gives lower held-out KL than representation-similarity scoring in all 12 paired runs. With labels from training or development splits of the evaluated task families, the target-adapted mode raises 3-bit pooled accuracy on the two Llama models by 4.3 and 4.5 points over the best single-family model. At 3 bits, unquantized embedding and output layers make up 43-46% of the packed artifact. All evaluations use general-domain benchmarks on a ground GPU; space-domain tasks and flight hardware are left to future work.

deep_dive.llm_tldr_en: Space-robot onboard language models need low-bit compression under fixed memory and behavioral fidelity. QSelect composes AWQ, GPTQ and AutoRound checkpoints into one static model, scoring each module substitution at the next-token distribution.
deep_dive.llm_tldr_cn: 星载语言模型需要低比特压缩，但通用训练后量化难以同时满足固定内存预算、静态产物与行为保真要求。作者提出 QSelect，把 AWQ、GPTQ 与 AutoRound 三类检查点按线性模块组合成单一低比特模型，并在最终下一词分布上为每次替换打分。实验显示该组合策略在受限存储与内存下仍保持接近全精度的行为。该工作为航天机器人等安全关键场景提供了可在地面验证的训练后量化流程。

quick_skim.title: PACE: Periodic and Channel-Aligned Encoding of Four-Bit Recurrent States
quick_skim.abstract: Linear-attention language models keep their context in a recurrent state of fixed size, where an inference system stores one copy of this state for every sequence it decodes at the same time. Storing the state at lower precision therefore lets more sequences share an accelerator. Existing state quantizers round the state after every generated token and report that four bits lose accuracy unless the bit width is raised or the model is fine-tuned.\par We introduce PACE, a post-hoc four-bit state quantizer. PACE rounds the state only once every few generated tokens, as chunked kernels already do once per chunk during prefill, and keeps the tokens generated in between in a small buffer. Rounding less often reduces the error that accumulates in the state. Additionally, we find that the large entries of the gated-delta state gather in columns, because some channels of the update written at each token remain large across many tokens. PACE therefore shares each quantization scale within one column. It also keeps the heads that retain rounding error longest at eight bits. On four hybrid models from 4B to 35B parameters, PACE with mixed four- and eight-bit heads is competitive with eight-bit DAMP on the three larger models at about two thirds of its memory, PACE with four-bit heads throughout scores higher than Q-Mamba at equal memory, and rounding every few tokens preserves the decoding speedup of the buffer.

quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: Existing state quantizers round linear-attention recurrent states every token and lose accuracy at four bits; PACE rounds once every few tokens and buffers intermediates, cutting accumulated error without fine-tuning.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 线性注意力语言模型需为每条并发解码序列保存一份固定大小的循环状态，低精度存储可让更多序列共享加速器，但现有状态量化器每生成一个token就舍入一次，四比特下精度明显下降。本文提出事后四比特量化器PACE，改为每隔若干生成token才对状态舍入一次，并把中间token暂存在小缓冲区中。减少舍入频率有效抑制了状态中累积的量化误差。该方案无需微调即可在四比特下维持精度，提升长序列推理的内存效率。
